title: NBA 2021-22 Panini Donruss Basketball #131 Jarrett Allen - Cleveland Cavaliers
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 2021-22 Panini Donruss Basketball trading card featuring Jarrett Allen of the Cleveland Cavaliers. This card is part of the base set with card number 131, and is a short print insert with a parallel/variety design. It is a non-autographed card produced by Panini for the National Basketball Association (NBA) season. This collectible item would be a valuable addition to any sports trading card collection for fans of both Jarrett Allen and the Cleveland Cavaliers.
